description.zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见[如何保证幂等性](~~25693~~)。
description.en: Ensures the idempotence of the request. The value is generated from your client and must be unique among different requests. ClientToken can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see [How to ensure idempotence](~~25693~~).
The list of cloud disk IDs.

description.zh:
本次调用期望查询的最大条目数。可配合NextToken参数一起使用。

取值范围：1~500。

默认值：10。
description.en:
The maximum number of entries to return in this call. You can use this parameter together with NextToken.

Valid values: 1 to 500.

Default value: 10.

description.zh: 查询凭证（Token）。取值为上一次调用该接口返回的NextToken参数值，初次调用接口时无需设置该参数。如果设置了NextToken，则请求参数PageSize和PageNumber将失效，且返回数据中的TotalCount无效。
description.en: The pagination token (Token). Set this parameter to the NextToken value returned in the previous call. You do not need to set this parameter for the first request. If NextToken is specified, the PageSize and PageNumber request parameters do not take effect, and the TotalCount value in the response is invalid.
The page number in a paging query.

description.zh: 分页查询时设置的每页行数。 取值范围1-100。
description.en: The number of entries per page in a paging query. Valid values: 1 to 100.
The list of snapshot policy IDs.

description.zh: 地域ID。您可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~25609~~)查看最新的阿里云地域列表。
description.en: The region ID. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) to query the most recent region list.

description.zh: 标签键值对。n的取值范围为 [1, 20]。
description.en: The tag key-value pairs. Valid values of N: 1 to 20.
The tag key of the resource.
The tag value of the resource.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ebs describe-enterprise-snapshot-policy --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --policy-ids esp-xxx --disk-ids d-bp67acfmxazb4p0000 --resource-group-id rg-acfmvs0000 --next-token AAAAAdDWBF20000 --max-results 100 --page-size 10 --page-number 1 --client-token 0c593ea1-3bea-11e9-b96b-88e9fe630000 --tag Value=tag-value Key=tag-key --region cn-hangzhou
